name: service1
description: Public-facing service. Exposes a single endpoint that fetches the current catalog from service2 and returns the average of its scores, as a whole number (integer division, no remainder). Runs the same computation regardless of which catalog service2 currently serves — there is no per-catalog path or result. Logs how many records it handled per request. Returns a structured 404 body for any path it does not serve. Does NOT define any behavior for what happens when service2's catalog is empty, and documents no 4xx/5xx response on its average endpoint.

dependencies.name: service2
dependencies.description: Fetches the current catalog of scored records to compute the average.
